hooks.text: That faint white cloud in our night sky isn't vapor.
Our sky's milky river is completely made of stars.
Four hundred billion stars hide inside our sky's white band.

title: The Night Sky's Milk Isn't a Cloud
description: For millennia, humans saw the Milky Way as a glowing cosmic cloud. In 1610, Galileo discovered it was actually a swarm of hundreds of billions of stars.

beats.text: That faint white cloud in our night sky isn't vapor.
beats.visual: photograph of the Milky Way arching over a dark night landscape, 2020

beats.text: For centuries, humans believed it was a hazy celestial fog.
beats.visual: historical woodcut print of ancient observers looking at the night sky

beats.text: Greek myth even claimed a goddess spilled her milk there.
beats.visual: Tintoretto painting The Origin of the Milky Way, 1575
subjects: The Origin of the Milky Way (Tintoretto)
queries: Tintoretto Origin of the Milky Way
Origin of the Milky Way painting

beats.text: Then in 1610, Galileo aimed his telescope at the band.
beats.visual: portrait of Galileo Galilei holding a spyglass telescope, 1636

beats.text: The milky fog instantly vanished into countless individual stars.
beats.visual: Galileo Galilei's original 1610 star cluster sketches from Sidereus Nuncius

beats.text: They are so distant our naked eyes blur them together.
beats.visual: ultra high resolution telescopic view resolving dense starfields in the galactic plane
queries: Milky Way star cloud dense stars

beats.text: Our disk actually holds up to 400 billion stars.
beats.visual: NASA artist concept of the Milky Way barred spiral stellar disk
queries: Milky Way barred spiral diagram NASA

beats.text: They all orbit a black hole of four million suns.
beats.visual: Chandra X-ray Observatory image of the galactic center around Sagittarius A*

beats.text: Yet to the unaided eye, our massive galaxy still looks like vapor.
beats.visual: wide field view of the Milky Way glowing across a starry dark sky
queries: Milky Way visible glowing band sky
Milky Way dark sky night view

better_than_last: Applies the proven myth_vs_fact structure and immediate contradiction hook to overturn a common celestial misconception.
